source.memory.concept.title: Conversational Memory
source.memory.concept.description: OmniRoute learns from every conversation, remembering facts, episodes, procedures, and semantic concepts that make responses more accurate and context-aware.
source.memory.concept.howWorksContent:
1. Automatic extraction: at the end of each response, facts and episodes are detected and saved automatically.
2. Retrieval: before each response, the most relevant memories are searched via FTS5 (exact), vector (semantic), or hybrid RRF.
3. Injection: relevant memories are injected into the assistant context to improve response quality.
4. Management: use this page to view, edit, export, and compact old memories.
source.memory.contentPlaceholder: Value or JSON content to remember
source.memory.deleteConfirmDesc: This action cannot be undone. The memory will be permanently removed.
source.memory.description: View and manage stored memory entries

target.memory.concept.title: 对话记忆
target.memory.concept.description: OmniRoute 从每次对话中学习，记住事实、事件、程序和语义概念，使响应更加准确和上下文感知。
target.memory.concept.howWorksContent:
1. 自动提取：在每个响应结束时，事实和事件会被自动检测并保存。
2. 检索：在每个响应之前，通过FTS5（精确）、向量（语义）或混合RRF搜索最相关的记忆。
3. 注入：相关记忆被注入到助手上下文中，以提高响应质量。
4. 管理：使用此页面查看、编辑、导出和压缩旧记忆。

target.memory.qdrantTutorialIntro: Qdrant 存储记忆的向量与元数据，用于检索相关上下文。它并不直接压缩 Token；节省是间接的——避免带入与当前请求无关的上下文。
target.memory.qdrantTutorialStep1: 在生产使用前，为服务器配置 HTTPS 与 API Key。
target.memory.qdrantTutorialStep2: 填写主机、端口、集合，以及一个 provider/model 格式且已配置凭据的模型。
target.memory.qdrantTutorialStep3: 集合维度必须与模型产出的维度一致。已有的 2048 维集合无法接收 1536 维的向量。
target.memory.qdrantTutorialStep4: 先保存、测试连接并运行搜索测试，然后再启用 Qdrant。

The weekly limit still applies and responses may wait for spare capacity.

source.providers.claudeAutoLimitResetDescriptio: When this account hits its 5-hour usage limit and a session-limit reset is available, OmniRoute claims it automatically and retries at full speed. Uses the account's once-a-week reset and still counts toward the weekly limit.

source.providers.webCookieProvidersDesc: These providers use browser web sessions, cookies, or web tokens instead of API keys. Open a provider to add the required session credential.
source.providers.apiKeyProvidersDesc: Standard API key providers. Add your key once and OmniRoute routes, retries, and rate-limits on your behalf.
source.providers.noAuthProvidersDesc: Open endpoints that require no credentials — ready to use immediately without any sign-up.
source.providers.upstreamProxyProvidersDesc: Route outbound traffic through an upstream proxy before it reaches the provider. Useful for corporate networks or traffic inspection.
source.providers.webFetchProvidersDesc: Providers that fetch and extract content from web URLs. Use them to ground prompts with live web data.
source.providers.aggregatorsGatewaysDesc: Multi-provider aggregators and AI gateways that expose a single unified API across dozens of underlying models.
source.providers.enterpriseCloudDesc: Enterprise-tier and cloud-hosted models with enhanced SLAs, compliance certifications, and dedicated capacity.
source.providers.cloudAgentProvidersDesc: Autonomous cloud agents that execute long-running tasks with plan approval and live status tracking.
source.providers.localProvidersDesc: Self-hosted models running on your own hardware. No data leaves your infrastructure.
source.providers.searchProvidersDesc: Web and document search providers. Attach them to LLM calls for Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
source.providers.audioProvidersDesc: Text-to-speech and speech-to-text providers for voice I/O and audio transcription pipelines.
source.providers.embeddingRerankProvidersDesc: Vector embedding and reranking providers for semantic search, RAG pipelines, and similarity scoring.
source.providers.imageProvidersDesc: Image generation and vision providers — create images from text or analyse existing ones.
source.providers.videoProvidersDesc: Video generation providers. Create short video clips from text prompts or images.
source.providers.onboardingWizardDescription: Connect API-key, custom compatible, and OAuth providers with validation, persistence, and an immediate connection test.

target.providers.webCookieProvidersDesc: 这些提供者使用浏览器网络会话、cookie 或网络令牌而不是 API 密钥。打开提供程序以添加所需的会话凭据。
target.providers.apiKeyProvidersDesc: 标准 API 密钥提供者。添加密钥后，OmniRoute 代为路由、重试和限流。
target.providers.noAuthProvidersDesc: 无需凭证的开放端点——无需注册即可立即使用。
target.providers.upstreamProxyProvidersDesc: 通过上游代理路由出站流量。适用于企业网络或流量审计场景。
target.providers.webFetchProvidersDesc: 从网页 URL 抓取和提取内容的提供者。用于将实时网页数据注入提示词。
target.providers.aggregatorsGatewaysDesc: 多提供者聚合器和 AI 网关，通过单一统一 API 对接数十个底层模型。
target.providers.enterpriseCloudDesc: 企业级和云托管模型，提供增强 SLA、合规认证和专用容量。
target.providers.cloudAgentProvidersDesc: 自主云代理，可执行长时间运行的任务，支持计划审批和实时状态跟踪。
target.providers.localProvidersDesc: 在您自己的硬件上运行的自托管模型。数据不会离开您的基础设施。
target.providers.searchProvidersDesc: 网页和文档搜索提供者。可附加到 LLM 调用以实现检索增强生成（RAG）。
target.providers.audioProvidersDesc: 文本转语音和语音转文本提供者，用于语音输入输出和音频转录管道。
target.providers.embeddingRerankProvidersDesc: 向量嵌入和重排序提供者，用于语义搜索、RAG 管道和相似度评分。
target.providers.imageProvidersDesc: 图像生成和视觉提供者——从文本创建图像或分析现有图像。
target.providers.videoProvidersDesc: 视频生成提供者。从文本提示或图像创建短视频片段。
target.providers.onboardingWizardDescription: 通过验证、持久性和即时连接测试连接 API 密钥、自定义兼容和 OAuth 提供者。

source.settings.routingClientCacheControlDesc: Configure whether OmniRoute preserves client-provided cache_control markers
source.settings.routingClientCacheControlAutoDe: For deterministic Claude-compatible flows, preserve client-provided cache_control as-is. If the request has no cache_control, OmniRoute does not inject any bridge-owned markers for CC-compatible third-party proxy compatibility.
source.settings.routingClientCacheControlAlways: Always forward client-provided cache_control headers to upstream providers as-is.
source.settings.routingClientCacheControlNeverD: Always remove client cache_control headers and let OmniRoute manage caching where native provider flows support it.
source.settings.routingZeroConfigDesc: Enable automatic provider selection using the auto/ prefix. When enabled, requests to auto, auto/coding, auto/fast, etc. will dynamically route across all connected providers.
source.settings.visionBridgeDesc: Run an automatic vision-to-text fallback before routing image requests to text-only models.
source.settings.visionBridgeEnabledDesc: Toggle the pre-call bridge that replaces image parts with extracted text.
source.settings.visionBridgeRerouteTextOnlyDesc: Send the complete request, including images, to the bridge model when the selected model has no image input.
source.settings.visionBridgeModelHint: Any OmniRoute model ID that supports vision can be used here.

target.settings.routingClientCacheControlDesc: 配置 OmniRoute 是否保留客户端提交的 cache_control 标记
target.settings.routingClientCacheControlAutoDe: 对于确定性的 Claude 兼容流程,按原样保留客户端提交的 cache_control。如果请求未携带 cache_control,OmniRoute 不会注入任何由桥接器拥有的标记,以兼容 CC 兼容的第三方代理。
target.settings.routingClientCacheControlAlways: 始终按原样将客户端提交的 cache_control 请求头转发给上游提供者。
target.settings.routingClientCacheControlNeverD: 始终移除客户端的 cache_control 请求头,在原生提供者流程支持时由 OmniRoute 管理缓存。
target.settings.routingZeroConfigDesc: 启用使用 auto/ 前缀的自动提供者选择。启用后,发往 auto、auto/coding、auto/fast 等的请求将在所有已连接提供者之间动态路由。
target.settings.visionBridgeDesc: 在将图像请求路由到纯文本模型之前,自动执行一次视觉到文本的回退。
target.settings.visionBridgeEnabledDesc: 切换预调用桥接,将图像内容替换为提取出的文本。
target.settings.visionBridgeRerouteTextOnlyDesc: 当所选模型没有图像输入时，将完整请求（包括图像）发送到桥接模型。
target.settings.visionBridgeModelHint: 可使用任何支持视觉的 OmniRoute 模型 ID。

source.quotaShare.conceptIntro: Quota Share divides a provider's quota among multiple API keys using work-conserving fair-share: each key receives a proportional slice but can borrow from the free balance without exceeding the global cap.
source.quotaShare.conceptFairShare: Fair-share: each key receives quota proportional to its configured weight
source.quotaShare.conceptBorrowing: Borrowing: keys can consume free balance from others without breaching the cap
source.quotaShare.conceptGlobalCap: Hard global cap: the provider's absolute limit is never exceeded
source.quotaShare.conceptWindows: Windows: 5h, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly — each tracked independently
source.quotaShare.conceptKeyHowDesc: Create the key normally in API Keys — it appears in the wizard's key step automatically. Tick Exclusive there to make it quota-only. No separate enable step.
source.quotaShare.conceptExclusiveDesc: An exclusive key only sees/uses the pool's quotaShared-* models — every other model is hidden from its /v1/models and blocked.

target.quotaShare.conceptIntro: 配额共享通过节约型公平分享将供应商的配额分配给多个 API 密钥：每个密钥获得一个按比例分配的份额，但可以在不超过全球上限的情况下从自由余额中借用。
target.quotaShare.conceptFairShare: 公平共享：每个键接收与其配置权重成比例的配额
target.quotaShare.conceptBorrowing: 借用：密钥可以在不违反上限的情况下消耗他人的自由余额
target.quotaShare.conceptGlobalCap: 硬性全球上限：供应商的绝对限制永远不会被超越
target.quotaShare.conceptWindows: Windows: 5小时，按小时、按日、按周、按月 — 每个独立跟踪
target.quotaShare.conceptKeyHowDesc: 在 API 管理器中正常创建密钥 — 它会自动出现在向导的密钥步骤中。在那里勾选独占以使其仅限配额。没有单独的启用步骤。
target.quotaShare.conceptExclusiveDesc: 独占密钥仅查看/使用池的 quotaShared-* 模型 — 其他所有模型在其 /v1/models 中被隐藏并被阻止。
target.quotaShare.migratedFromLocalStorageNotic: 池成功从 localStorage 迁移。

source.agentSkills.catalog.cli-plugins-skills.d: Manage Omni Skills (list, install, test, remove), plugins (create, configure), and persistent memory (search, add, clear) from the CLI.
source.agentSkills.catalog.cli-setup.name: CLI: Setup & Config
source.agentSkills.catalog.cli-setup.descriptio: Run initial setup, configure global CLI settings, manage environment variables, check for updates, and configure autostart via the CLI setup and config commands.
Detect installed CLI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Cline and more), search GitHub for matching agent skills, and install them to the detected tools via OmniRoute's built-in APIs.
source.agentSkills.catalog.config-codex-cli.des: Step-by-step agent workflow to configure the OpenAI Codex CLI on any machine (Linux, macOS, Windows) to use OmniRoute as an OpenAI-compatible backend. Detects OS and shell, writes config.toml and 7 named profiles, sets environment variables, and verifies the setup.
source.agentSkills.catalog.omni-github-skills.d: Search, score, scan, and import agent skills from GitHub repositories that contain SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, and similar agent skill files. Discover community skills across 160+ provider categories, evaluate relevance with heuristic scoring, check for malware or hardcoded secrets, and install into Hermes, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenCode agent directories.
source.agentSkills.pageSubtitle: Teach your agent to operate OmniRoute — 23 API areas + 21 CLI families
source.agentSkills.conceptCard.agent.title: Agent Skills — Outbound
source.agentSkills.conceptCard.agent.descriptio: Agent Skills are machine-readable SKILL.md documents that external AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot…) fetch from GitHub to learn how to operate OmniRoute via REST or CLI. They are read by the agent, not executed by OmniRoute.
source.agentSkills.conceptCard.omni.title: Omni Skills — Inbound
source.agentSkills.conceptCard.omni.description: Omni Skills are sandbox tools that OmniRoute injects into the model's context on every request. They are executed by OmniRoute, not read by the agent.

target.agentSkills.catalog.cli-plugins-skills.d: 通过 CLI 管理 Omni Skills（列出、安装、测试、移除）、插件（创建、配置）和持久记忆（搜索、添加、清除）。
target.agentSkills.catalog.cli-setup.name: CLI: 设置与配置
target.agentSkills.catalog.cli-setup.descriptio: 通过 CLI setup 和 config 命令运行初始设置、配置全局 CLI 设置、管理环境变量、检查更新以及配置自动启动。
检测已安装的 CLI 编程工具（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Cline 等），在 GitHub 上搜索匹配的 agent 技能，并通过 OmniRoute 的内置 API 将其安装到检测到的工具中。
target.agentSkills.catalog.config-codex-cli.des: 分步 agent 工作流，用于在任何机器（Linux、macOS、Windows）上配置 OpenAI Codex CLI，以将 OmniRoute 用作兼容 OpenAI 的后端。检测操作系统和 shell，写入 config.toml 和 7 个命名配置文件，设置环境变量，并验证设置。
target.agentSkills.catalog.omni-github-skills.d: 从包含 SKILL.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursorrules 及类似 agent 技能文件的 GitHub 仓库中搜索、评分、扫描和导入 agent 技能。发现跨 160 多个提供者类别的社区技能，通过启发式评分评估相关性，检查恶意软件或硬编码机密，并安装到 Hermes、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 或 OpenCode agent 目录中。
target.agentSkills.pageSubtitle: 教你的智能体操作OmniRoute— 22 个API区域 + 20 个CLI家族
target.agentSkills.conceptCard.agent.title: 代理技能 — 外呼
target.agentSkills.conceptCard.agent.descriptio: 代理技能是机器可读的 SKILL.md 文档，外部 AI 代理（Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等）从 GitHub 获取这些文档，以了解如何通过 REST 或 CLI 操作 OmniRoute。它们由代理读取，而不是由 OmniRoute 执行。
target.agentSkills.conceptCard.omni.title: 全能技能 — 入站
target.agentSkills.conceptCard.omni.description: Omni Skills 是 OmniRoute 在每个请求中注入到模型上下文中的沙盒工具。它们由 OmniRoute 执行，而不是由代理读取。

source.docs.clientWindsurfBullet3: Use Dashboard -> CLI Tools for a ready-made Windsurf configuration guide.
source.docs.clientClineBullet1: Cline works best with explicit provider/model prefixes so the router never has to guess the backend.
source.docs.clientClineBullet2: Use `/v1/chat/completions` for general models and reuse the same OmniRoute base URL across different accounts.
source.docs.clientClineBullet3: Use the Providers dashboard to validate OAuth/API key before debugging Cline runtime issues.
source.docs.clientKimiBullet1: Use OmniRoute as a stable base URL while rotating accounts or provider combos underneath.
source.docs.clientKimiBullet2: Prefer prefixed models in coding flows so fallback and audit trail remain explicit.
source.docs.clientKimiBullet3: Use `/v1/responses` when you want native Responses-style routing for tool-using clients.
source.docs.protocolsDescription: OmniRoute exposes two operational protocols in addition to OpenAI-compatible APIs: MCP for tool execution and A2A for agent-to-agent workflows.
source.docs.protocolMcpDesc: Use MCP over stdio to let clients discover and call OmniRoute tools with audit visibility.
source.docs.protocolMcpStep2: Point your MCP client to stdio transport.
source.docs.protocolA2aDesc: Use A2A JSON-RPC to submit tasks synchronously or via SSE streaming.

target.docs.clientWindsurfBullet3: 使用仪表盘 -> CLI 工具获取现成的 Windsurf 配置指南。
target.docs.clientClineBullet1: Cline 最适合使用显式的提供者/模型前缀，这样路由器无需猜测后端。
target.docs.clientClineBullet2: 常规模型使用 `/v1/chat/completions`，并在不同账户间复用同一个 OmniRoute base URL。
target.docs.clientClineBullet3: 调试 Cline 运行时问题前，请使用提供者仪表盘验证 OAuth/API 密钥。
target.docs.clientKimiBullet1: 轮换底层账户或提供者组合时，将 OmniRoute 用作稳定的 base URL。
target.docs.clientKimiBullet2: 在编码流程中优先使用带前缀的模型，让回退和审计轨迹保持明确。
target.docs.clientKimiBullet3: 当你希望为使用工具的客户端启用原生 Responses 风格路由时，请使用 `/v1/responses`。
target.docs.protocolsDescription: 除了 OpenAI 兼容 API 之外，OmniRoute 还提供两类操作协议：用于工具执行的 MCP，以及用于智能体协作工作流的 A2A。
target.docs.protocolMcpDesc: 通过 stdio 使用 MCP，让客户端发现并调用 OmniRoute 工具，同时具备审计可见性。
target.docs.protocolMcpStep1: 使用 `omniroute --mcp` 启动 MCP 传输。
target.docs.protocolMcpStep2: 将你的 MCP 客户端指向 stdio 传输。
target.docs.protocolMcpStep3: 调用 `omniroute_get_health` 和 `omniroute_list_combos` 验证连通性。
target.docs.protocolA2aDesc: 使用 A2A JSON-RPC 以同步方式或通过 SSE 流式方式提交任务。
target.docs.protocolA2aStep1: 读取 `/.well-known/agent.json` 进行智能体发现。
target.docs.protocolA2aStep2: 向 `POST /a2a` 发送 `message/send` 或 `message/stream` 请求。

source.combos.strategyRecommendations.strict-ra: Ideal for load balancing across multiple API accounts.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.fill-firs: Exhaust provider quotas sequentially before falling back.
Use for quota-based routing with clear fallback chains.
Set quotas accurately to avoid premature fallback.
Works best with providers offering free tiers or credit buckets.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.auto.desc: Route based on real-time scoring for cost, latency, quality, and health.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.auto.tip1: Let the engine balance multiple factors automatically.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.auto.tip2: Monitor which factors drive routing decisions in logs.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.auto.tip3: Use for complex workloads where no single factor dominates.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.lkgp.desc: Route based on historical performance and success patterns.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.lkgp.tip1: Requires sufficient request history for accurate predictions.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.lkgp.tip2: Good for workloads with consistent model performance patterns.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.lkgp.tip3: Monitor prediction accuracy and adjust weights as needed.
source.combos.strategyRecommendations.context-o: Optimize routing based on context window usage and token efficiency.
Route long conversations to models with larger context windows.
Monitor context utilization to avoid token waste.
Best for conversational AI requiring extensive context retention.

target.combos.strategyRecommendations.strict-ra: 非常适合在多个 API 账户之间做负载均衡。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.fill-firs: 在切换到链中的下一个提供者之前，先耗尽一个提供者的配额。
按免费配额大小排列模型 — 最大的放在第一位。
启用健康检查以跳过已耗尽的提供者。
非常适合免费层级堆叠（Deepgram → Groq → NIM）。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.auto.desc: 基于成本、延迟、质量和健康的实时评分进行路由。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.auto.tip1: 让引擎自动平衡多个因素。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.auto.tip2: 在日志中监控哪些因素驱动路由决策。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.auto.tip3: 用于复杂工作负载，其中没有单一因素占主导。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.lkgp.desc: 基于历史成功率和持久性能数据进行路由。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.lkgp.tip1: 在依赖此策略之前让成功历史积累足够数据。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.lkgp.tip2: 最适合具有稳定性能特征的工作负载。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.lkgp.tip3: 定期审查历史数据，确保路由决策保持准确。
target.combos.strategyRecommendations.context-o: 基于上下文窗口使用情况和令牌效率优化路由。
将长对话路由到具有更大上下文窗口的模型。
监控上下文利用率以避免令牌浪费。
最适合需要大量上下文保留的对话式 AI。
